categories.label: Email & inbox
categories.definition: Inbox triage, cleanup, unsubscribing, search, summaries, drafting and sending replies.

categories.label: Saving money on bills & subscriptions
categories.definition: Bill negotiation, insurance shopping, finding credits/rewards, and finding or cancelling subscriptions (old codes SAVE + SUBS, counted once per post). Bare 'it saved me $X' claims with no method are not counted here.

categories.label: Travel
categories.definition: Flights, hotels, trains, check-in, rebooking and trip planning.

categories.label: Shopping
categories.definition: Buying things online, including finding deals and promo codes.

categories.label: Customer service & refunds
categories.definition: Dealing with a company's support: refunds, claims, disputes, returns, compensation.

categories.label: Research & recommendations
categories.definition: Looking things up, answering questions, comparing options, recommendations.

categories.label: Work & business tasks
categories.definition: Work operations: leads, outreach, CRM, analytics, invoices, recruiting, ops.

categories.label: Personal finance & payments
categories.definition: Paying bills, budgeting, tracking spending, taxes, investments, payments.

categories.label: Calendar & scheduling
categories.definition: Managing the calendar, scheduling and rescheduling meetings.

categories.label: Content & social media
categories.definition: Writing posts, social media management, making images, video or other media.

categories.label: Family & kids
categories.definition: Tasks done explicitly for kids, a spouse, parents or other family (added alongside the task code).

categories.label: Building apps & code
categories.definition: Building apps, websites, scripts and fixing code.

categories.label: Events & tickets
categories.definition: Concerts, sports, shows, activities and ticket buying.

categories.label: Hobbies & entertainment
categories.definition: Hobbies, games, cooking, creative and entertainment projects.

categories.label: Price & availability alerts
categories.definition: Watching prices, stock, reservations or award seats and alerting or acting when they change.

categories.label: Reminders & follow-ups
categories.definition: Reminders, follow-ups and deadline tracking.

categories.label: Briefings & meeting prep
categories.definition: Daily briefings, digests, news summaries and meeting prep.

categories.label: Restaurant reservations
categories.definition: Booking or changing restaurant tables.

categories.label: Groceries & food ordering
categories.definition: Ordering groceries, takeout and coffee.

categories.label: Appointments & local services
categories.definition: Booking appointments and local services (doctors, salons, handymen, classes).

categories.label: Health admin
categories.definition: Health and medical admin: records, insurance claims, prescriptions, fitness tracking.

categories.label: Forms & paperwork
categories.definition: Filling forms, paperwork, government and civic admin.

categories.label: Job search
categories.definition: Finding jobs and applying.

categories.label: Documents & notes
categories.definition: Documents, spreadsheets, notes and personal knowledge base.

categories.label: Selling items
categories.definition: Marketplace/Craigslist listings and buyer messages.

categories.label: Coordinating with people
categories.definition: Messaging people or other agents on the user's behalf, group plans.

categories.label: Rides & transport
categories.definition: Rides, transit and navigation.

categories.label: Home & utilities
categories.definition: Home, utilities, energy and smart-home tasks.

categories.label: Web scraping & data
categories.definition: Scraping websites and extracting data.

categories.label: Testing the agent (not ranked)
categories.definition: Probing or testing the agent itself with no real task. Not ranked.

categories.label: General opinion, no use case (not ranked)
categories.definition: Opinion about the product with no specific use case (incl. bare 'it saved me $X' claims). Not ranked.
